Meteorology

Aviso de Furacão

A formal announcement by maritime or meteorological authorities indicating that hurricane conditions, including very high winds and heavy seas, are expected in the area.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Aviso de Furacão?

In this glossary, Aviso de Furacão refers to: A formal announcement by maritime or meteorological authorities indicating that hurricane conditions, including very high winds and heavy seas, are expected in the area.

How is Aviso de Furacão used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Atenção a todos os navios: aviso de furacão em vigor para Metarea IV. Prepare-se para tempo severo e acompanhe as atualizações a cada hora."

Why does Aviso de Furacão matter in maritime?

Aviso de Furacão matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Aviso de Furacão?

Aviso de Furacão is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Aviso de Furacão belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

A formal announcement by maritime or meteorological authorities indicating that hurricane conditions, including very high winds and heavy seas, are expected in the area.

Operational example

Attention all vessels: Hurricane warning is now in force for Metarea IV. Secure for severe weather and monitor updates every hour.

Localized term

Aviso de Furacão

Localized example
